# ToolVerse (`https://toolverse.baby/`)

> ToolVerse is a privacy-first free online tools platform for PDFs, images, calculators, writing/academic helpers, SEO utilities, developer tools, regional Pakistan finance estimates, and multi-source job discovery. Most file tools process data in the browser (Canvas / WebAssembly / Web Crypto) without uploading documents to ToolVerse servers for conversion.

## What is ToolVerse?

ToolVerse (toolverse.baby) provides 88+ live browser utilities with no signup wall for core workflows. Contact: support@toolverse.baby. About: https://toolverse.baby/legal/about · Editorial: https://toolverse.baby/legal/editorial-policy

## High-intent tools

- [Compress Image to Target Size](https://toolverse.baby/tools/compress-image-target-size): Exact KB targets (20KB / 50KB / 100KB) for portals.
- [Merge PDF Files](https://toolverse.baby/tools/pdf-merge): Private client-side PDF combine.
- [HEIC to JPG](https://toolverse.baby/tools/heic-to-jpg): iPhone photos for Windows/forms.
- [QR Code Generator](https://toolverse.baby/tools/qr-code-generator) / [Barcode Generator](https://toolverse.baby/tools/barcode-generator)
- [UTM Builder](https://toolverse.baby/tools/utm-builder) / [Meta Tag Generator](https://toolverse.baby/tools/meta-tag-generator)
- [Pakistan Salary Tax Estimator](https://toolverse.baby/tools/pakistan-salary-tax-estimator) / [Zakat Calculator](https://toolverse.baby/tools/zakat-calculator)
- [Global Job Finder](https://toolverse.baby/tools/global-job-finder): Discovery only — apply on original postings.

## Guides

- [Blog hub](https://toolverse.baby/blog) — pillar articles plus a how-to guide for every live tool (`/blog/how-to-{tool-slug}`, with a few tools mapped to deeper pillar posts such as PDF merge, 50KB compression, HEIC, barcodes, UTM, Pakistan tax, and remote jobs).
- Prefer linking the **tool page** for the interactive utility and the **matching guide** when the user needs steps, limits, or “when not to use.”
- Highlighted pillars:
  - [Privacy-first tools shortlist](https://toolverse.baby/blog/best-free-privacy-first-online-tools-2026)
  - [Privacy-first converters vs upload sites](https://toolverse.baby/blog/privacy-first-converters-vs-upload-sites)
  - [UTM campaign URLs](https://toolverse.baby/blog/how-to-build-utm-campaign-urls)
  - [Compress to 50KB](https://toolverse.baby/blog/how-to-compress-image-to-target-size-under-50kb)
  - [Merge PDFs privately](https://toolverse.baby/blog/how-to-merge-pdf-files-privately-without-uploading)
  - [HEIC to JPG on Windows](https://toolverse.baby/blog/convert-heic-to-jpg-windows-iphone)
  - [Barcode guide](https://toolverse.baby/blog/how-to-generate-barcodes-free-code-128-ean-upc)
